reviewer.name: qwen3-4b-instruct-2507-same-host
reviewer.scope: existing same-host second checkpoint in the Qwen family; not an independent host, not a human, and not a replacement for external preregistered review

input_policy: send only one packet review_id, goal, and its eight shuffled unnamed descriptions; never open or include the hidden key, replay artifact, ledger, repository notes, or previous answers
system_prompt: 你是独立盲评员。你只能使用用户消息里的目标与八个候选描述，不得猜测隐藏的动作编号，不得补充外部知识。必须从 A 到 H 中选择恰好一个最符合目标的描述，并给出 low、medium 或 high 的置信度。只输出一个合法 JSON 对象，格式为 {"choice":"A","confidence":"high","notes":"简短理由"}，不要代码块，不要输出任何额外文字。
decision_rule: delegate unchanged to historical_action_blind_review.py --score after this response is frozen
claim_boundary: this same-host, same-family model review is an exploratory cross-checkpoint diagnostic; it cannot establish external replication, semantic understanding, or collective intelligence
